name: Equivalence Relation Formulation
description: Transforms the graph connectivity problem into an algebraic equivalence relation problem. Edges become available pairwise equivalences, paths become the transitive closure of these equivalences, and the core banks become a subset of critical variables that must all belong to the same equivalence class. This completely removes graph-theoretic cues (nodes, edges, paths, routing) while preserving the exact Steiner Tree mathematics.
